name: Fused SVD-Linear Layer with SRAM-Resident RMSNorm & Dual-Projection.
description: Fused SVD-Linear Layer with SRAM-Resident RMSNorm & Dual-Projection.  RESEARCH FIX: Eliminates GPU High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM) roundtrip latency by fusing:     1. Down-projection: Z = X @ V^T  (hidden_dim -> rank)     2. In-SRAM RMSNorm: Z_norm = Z * rsqrt(mean(Z^2) + eps) * weight     3. Up-projection:   Y = Z_norm @ U^T + bias (rank -> out_dim)  The intermediate activation matrix Z \in R^{B x L

components.name: Factor U (Full-Rank Expansion Projection)
components.math_latex: y_t = z_t (\Sigma_r U_r^\top) + b, \quad U_r \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}

components.name: Residual LoRA / Norm Calibration
components.math_latex: \Delta y_t = x_t (B A)^\top \cdot \frac{\alpha}{r}, \quad A \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_{in}}, \; B \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}
